title: 俗世凡尘 第17章 比试下俗世凡尘 第18章 修炼

话说建王作为贵客，他本来是坐在最高台阶上的座位上，但是他太想看陆多福挨揍了。沈固打陆多福，建王不自觉地把自个带入其中，于是走到最下面来靠近了看。按理说，有人比武，旁人是不准下场干扰的，但碍于建王的身份，也没人说他。
沈固冲过来暴起一脚，直踢陆多福的小腹。八成力道的一拳，陆多福已被打得只剩“半条命”，这全力的一脚，踢的又是脆弱的小腹部位，这要是踢中了，陆多福纵使不死，也绝对不可能再起来。南宫月和白玉溪转过了头，不忍再看。
陆多福忽地侧了下身，转到建王去了。沈固这一脚如果踢出去了，那肯定会踢中建王。以建王的身份，不管受伤与否，沈固的下场均不会好过。
沈固目现恐惧，惊叫一声，强行收力。但他这一脚是全力踢出，要收力谈何容易。只听“啪”一声，沈固为了收力，扭曲了自己身体，撞上了旁边的石护栏，竟然生生将腿骨扭折，他惨叫一声，重重摔在地上。
等的就是现在，陆多福高高跃起，借坠地之力，一肘重击在沈固小腹。这是他以前打架时候，一个乞丐教他的，说什么宁挨十拳，不挨一肘，用肘子打人肚子，最是厉害。沈固一声闷哼。陆多福得理不饶人，一屁股坐在沈固身上，一拳接一拳尽数打在他脸上。
沈固连声惨叫，陆多福却不敢缓手，拳头如雨点般落下。沈固满脸飚血，牙齿也被打下两颗。
这一变故，惊呆了一众宾客。直到沈固被打成猪头，蔺庄才反应过来，怒道：“住手，小畜生，快住手。”随即纵身一跃，将陆多福一把抓起摔到一边，将沈固扶起身来。
沈固脸上血肉模糊，嘴里模模糊糊地吐出几个字：“我……认……输……”方才还趾高气扬地要将陆多福打死，此时却被打得这样，真是令人唏嘘。
看着徒弟的惨状，蔺庄越想越气，怒喝一声：“小畜生，本座毙了你。”右手挥出，凌空向陆多福拍出一掌。武王境高手，隔空杀人易如反掌。这记劈空掌看似随意，但若陆多福被打中的话，保证全身连骨头都没一块会是完好的。
“蔺兄，手下留情。”南宫修也立即出手，拦截了掌力。“嘭”，两人掌力撞在一起，余波所到之处，年轻弟子无不人仰马翻。陆多福离得最近，硬生生被震出一丈远。白玉溪赶紧抢出，抱起陆多福，远离了蔺庄。南宫月和一众云隐门弟子凝神戒备，防止蔺庄暴起伤人。
蔺庄怒喝道：“怎么着，凭你们几个，也想拦住本座？识相的滚开，否则本座连你们一块杀。”
南宫修朝众弟子摆摆手，示意无碍，沉声道：“蔺兄，停手吧。你远来是客，我应敬你，但若蔺兄坚持对小徒出手，那小弟只能领教的蔺兄的破云刀了。”
蔺庄一声狂笑：“就凭你？”徒手一抓，一柄造型古朴的单刀已握在手中，戟指怒目道：“你云隐门有多少人，一起上吧！”
以修为而论，南宫修是武王境七重，蔺庄是武王境九重。武尊以上，一重修为一重天，除非是少数可以越级挑战的挂逼男主，而南宫修明显不属于此类，所以南宫修对阵蔺庄没得打。在场边的云隐门众人，修为最高的三个长老，一个是武王境二重，两个武宗境九重，另外白玉溪是武尊境九重，如果参战的话，他们连添头都算不上。至于其他弟子，直接忽略不计了，反正不管怎么算，蔺庄确实有狂妄的资本，他一人打云隐门这几个人绰绰有余。
一个声音冷冷地道：“蔺庄。你是当我们都不存在是吗？耍威风也不看看场合，你是把这当自己家了吧？”说话的正是永乐公主，她冷若冰霜的神色，不带一丝感情。
蔺庄犹如被当头一棒，丧失了方才的狂气，垂头丧气地道：“公主殿下，可是沈固被这小子的奸计所害……”
“够了，”永乐公主毫不留情地打断：“别再提你那个废物徒弟，武修境四重打不过一个不能修炼的人，你还在当宝贝护着呢？还有你，堂堂武王境高手，居然对一个手无缚鸡之力的小辈出手，你这身本事都练到狗身上去了吗？”永乐公主毫不留情面，怼得蔺庄哑口无言。
陆多福用了诡计，这所有人都看得出来，但这也无可厚非，所有人也都看得出来陆多福是被建王赶鸭子上架强行架上场的。除此诡计，他们也实在想不出陆多福该怎么赢。
不过，也有人不乐意了，比如建王，他本来就想看陆多福挨揍，结果打成这样，他大失所望。只听他小声地道：“姐，我觉得蔺宗主说的对，那小子要不是用奸计，根本不可能是沈固的对手！”

永乐公主怒道：“闭嘴，输了就是输了，规则并没有说不能用计谋。沈固轻敌自大，活该挨打。还有你，你以为我不知道你安的什么心？什么宗门道义，让一个不能修炼的人去挑战武修境四重的对手，亏你想得出来。若换成是你，早被打死了吧？你一再惹事，看回宫后我禀告父皇，以后你就别想再出宫了。”
永乐公主帮理不帮亲，连自家弟弟都不给面子，建王噤若寒蝉，不敢再言语。
南宫修拱拱手道：“谢殿下为小徒解难。多福，快拜谢公主殿下。”
陆多福赶紧爬起身来，朝永乐公主跪下道：“小人感谢公主殿下，公主冰雪聪明，仗义执言，小人虽百死不足为报。”
南宫月小声嘀咕道：“这小福子，什么时候学的油嘴滑舌的，拍马屁都一套一套的……”
永乐公主面无表情地道：“罢了，平身吧。既为公证人，本公主自当主持公道，还你公平。你能赢也算本事，本公主自当履行承诺，老四，把小灵丹给他吧？”
建王讶道：“不会吧，这还给他？”忽地看见永乐公主面色不善，无奈叹了口气道：“行吧！便宜这小子了。”从空间行囊中取出上品小灵丹，分发给一众参加比试的弟子。轮到陆多福时，建王故意手抖一下，小灵丹掉落在地，陆多福微微一笑，不以为意，俯身拾起。
永乐公主起身道：“今日之事，就此为止吧。蔺宗主，令徒伤得不轻，带回去疗伤吧。这有一瓶天香断续膏，你拿回去用吧。”
天香断续膏，皇室独门秘方，对断骨接续有奇效。蔺庄受宠若惊，接过膏药，领着弟子抬起沈固喜滋滋去了。
好手段，这还真是打一巴掌再给个甜枣。这永乐公主恩威并施，蔺庄不记恨今日之辱，反而因得公主赐药而沾沾自喜。以后若是皇室让他卖命，估计就容易得多了。
永乐公主又道：“南宫掌门，感谢招待，本公主不再叨扰，这就回宫了。在场诸位，若有机缘，我们皇城再会！”召唤灵兽，领着建王飞走了。
众人纷纷拜别：“恭送两位殿下！”随着蔺庄和皇室之人相继离开，这场寿宴也就结束，各宗门纷纷告辞。
“总算结束了。”白云溪长叹一口气。南宫修摇头道：“此事恐怕没这么简单，蔺庄和建王睚眦必报。招惹了他们，恐不能善了。对了，多福伤势如何？”
陆多福道：“师父，我没事。”
南宫月白了她一眼：“还说没事，你都吐血了。爹，你可得给他好好看看。”
南宫修抱起陆多福道：“这个自然，先回去再说。”又交代两个长老：“两位师弟，带弟子们去疗伤吧！”
盖广走上前道：“陆师弟，今日多谢了，以前为兄多有得罪，还请见谅。”这些弟子以前都看不起陆多福，总是废物长废物短的。今日这个他们眼中的“废物”不仅赢下了一场为云隐门避免了被零封的尴尬，还为他们赢得上品小灵丹，盖广由衷感激。
南宫月“哼”了一声道：“知道就好，看你们还敢看不起小福子，你们是该好好谢谢他，要不是他，你们一场都赢不下。”
众弟子纷纷道：“月儿师妹说的是，是我们无能，给宗门丢脸，还全仗陆师弟，以后但凡陆师弟有所需，我们必尽全力相助。”
南宫修微微一笑：“甚好，既为同宗，就该齐心协力，互帮互助。今日之事，不怪你们，你们已尽力了。不过从今以后，可要好好修炼才是。去吧，下去好好养伤修整。”

“谢掌门，我等告退！”

As a distinguished guest, King Jian was supposed to sit on the seat on the highest step, but he really wanted to see Lu Duofu get beaten. When Shen Gu beat Lu Duofu, King Jian unconsciously brought himself into it, so he walked to the bottom to take a closer look. It stands to reason that when someone is competing in martial arts, others are not allowed to interfere, but due to King Jian's status, no one said anything about him.
Shen Gu rushed over and kicked Lu Duofu directly in the abdomen. A punch with 80% force, Lu Duofu was beaten to "half life". This full-force kick hit the fragile lower abdomen. If this kick hit, Lu Duofu would never be able to get up again even if he survived. Nangong Yue and Bai Yuxi turned their heads and couldn't bear to look anymore.
Lu Duofu suddenly turned sideways and turned to King Jian. If Shen Gu kicks out, he will definitely kick Zhongjian Wang. As King Jian, no matter whether he is injured or not, Shen Gu's end will not be easy.
Shen Gu's eyes showed fear, he screamed and forcibly withdrew his strength. But he kicked this kick with all his strength, and it was not easy to hold back. Hearing a "pop" sound, Shen Gu twisted his body in order to absorb his strength and hit the stone guardrail next to him, twisting his leg bones. He screamed and fell heavily to the ground.
What he was waiting for was now. Lu Duofu jumped up high and used the force of falling to the ground to hit Shen Gu hard in the abdomen with his elbow. This is what a beggar taught him when he was fighting before, saying that he would rather receive ten punches than one elbow. Hitting someone in the stomach with an elbow is the most powerful. Shen Gu groaned. Lu Duofu was unforgiving and sat down on Shen Gu, punching him in the face one after another.
Shen Gu screamed repeatedly, but Lu Duofu didn't dare to slow down, and his fists fell like raindrops. Shen Gu's face was covered in blood, and two of his teeth were knocked out.
This turn of events shocked all the guests. It wasn't until Shen Gu was beaten into a pig's head that Lin Zhuang came to his senses and said angrily: "Stop it, you little beast, stop it quickly." Then he jumped up, grabbed Lu Duofu and threw him aside, and helped Shen Gu up.
Shen Gu's face was bloody and bloody, and he spat out a few words vaguely: "I... admit... defeat..." Just now he was arrogantly about to beat Lu Duofu to death, but now he was beaten like this. It was really sad.
Seeing the miserable condition of his apprentice, Lin Zhuang became angrier as he thought about it, and shouted angrily: "Little beast, I'll kill you." He waved his right hand and slapped Lu Duofu in the air. A master of the Martial King Realm can easily kill people from afar. This air splitting palm seemed random, but if Lu Duofu was hit, it is guaranteed that not even a bone in his body would be intact.
"Brother Lin, please be merciful." Nangong Xiu also immediately took action and intercepted the palm power. "Bang", the two palms collided with each other, and wherever the aftermath hit, all the young disciples were thrown off their feet. Lu Duofu was the closest and was suddenly shaken ten feet away. Bai Yuxi rushed out, picked up Lu Duofu, and moved away from Linzhuang. Nangong Yue and a group of Yunyin Sect disciples were on alert to prevent Linzhuang from getting angry and hurting anyone.
Linzhuang shouted angrily: "What's the matter, you guys want to stop me? Get out of here, otherwise I will kill you too."
Nangong Xiu waved his hands to the disciples, indicating that there was no problem, and said in a deep voice: "Brother Lin, stop it. You are a guest from afar, and I should respect you. But if Brother Lin insists on taking action against the disciple, then I will only have to use Brother Lin's Poyun Sword."
Linzhuang laughed wildly: "It's just you?" He grabbed it with his bare hands and found a simple-looking single sword in his hand. His halberd finger glared angrily: "How many people do you have in Yunyin Sect? Come on together!"
In terms of cultivation, Nangong Xiu is at the seventh level of the King of Martial Realm, and Linzhuang is at the ninth level of the King of Martial Realm. Martial Lord and above, the first level of cultivation is the first level of heaven, unless there are a few cool male protagonists who can leapfrog the challenge, and Nangong Xiu obviously does not fall into this category, so Nangong Xiu has no chance to fight against Linzhuang. Among the Yunyin Sect members on the sidelines, the three elders with the highest cultivation level are one at the second level of the Martial King Realm, two at the ninth level of the Wuzong Realm, and Bai Yuxi is at the ninth level of the Martial Master Realm. If they participate in the battle, they willAdding a head doesn't even count. As for the other disciples, they are simply ignored. No matter how you calculate it, Linzhuang does have arrogant capital. He is more than enough to defeat the Yunyin Sect alone.
A voice said coldly: "Linzhuang, do you think we don't exist? You don't care about the occasion when you are showing off your authority. Do you regard this as your own home?" It was Princess Yongle who spoke, with a frosty look on her face, without any emotion.
Linzhuang felt as if he had been hit in the head, losing all the madness he had just now, and said dejectedly: "Your Highness, Shen Gu was harmed by this kid's cunning plan..."
"That's enough," Princess Yongle interrupted mercilessly: "Don't mention that useless apprentice of yours. The fourth level of martial arts realm can't beat a person who can't practice, and you are still protecting him as a treasure? And you, a master of the martial king realm, actually attack a junior who has no power to bind a chicken. Have you trained all your skills on a dog?" Princess Yongle showed no mercy, leaving Linzhuang speechless.
Everyone could see that Lu Duofu had used a trick, but it was understandable. Everyone could also see that Lu Duofu was forced into the game by King Jian. Apart from this trick, they really couldn't figure out how Lu Duofu could win.
However, some people were not happy, such as King Jian. He originally wanted to see Lu Duofu get beaten, but he was disappointed when the result was like this. Just listen to him whispering: "Sister, I think Sect Leader Lin is right. If that kid hadn't used cunning tricks, there is no way he could be Shen Gu's opponent!"
Princess Yongle said angrily: "Shut up, if you lose, you lose. The rules don't say you can't use tricks. Shen Gu underestimates the enemy and is arrogant, so he deserves to be beaten. And you, do you think I don't know what you are worried about? What kind of sect morals, let You can't imagine that a person who can't cultivate would challenge an opponent at the fourth level of martial arts. If it were you, you would have been beaten to death, wouldn't you? If you keep causing trouble, I will report it to the emperor after you return to the palace, and you will never leave the palace again."
Princess Yongle did not help her relatives, and even refused to give face to her own brother. King Jian remained silent and did not dare to speak any more.
Nangong Xiu Gong cupped his hands and said, "Thank you, Your Highness, for resolving this little disciple's problem. Thank you so much. Thank you, Your Highness, Princess."
Lu Duofu quickly got up, knelt down towards Princess Yongle and said, "I would like to thank Your Highness the Princess. Princess Bingxue is smart and speaks uprightly. Even if I die hundreds of times, this is not enough repayment."
Nangong Yue whispered in a low voice: "When did this little Fuzi learn to be smooth-tongued and flattering..."
Princess Yongle said expressionlessly: "That's all, let's get a peaceful life. As a notary, I am responsible for upholding justice and giving you justice. If you can win, it counts as your ability, and I must fulfill my promise. Fourth son, give him the little elixir, right?"
King Jian asked in surprise: "No way, give this back to him?" Suddenly he saw Princess Yongle's expression was not kind, he sighed helplessly and said: "Okay! This kid is easier." He took out the high-grade small elixir from the space bag and distributed it to all the disciples participating in the competition. When it was Lu Duofu's turn, King Jian deliberately shook his hand and the elixir fell to the ground. Lu Duofu smiled slightly, didn't care, and leaned over to pick it up.
Princess Yongle stood up and said: "Let's end today's matter. Master Lin, your disciple is seriously injured, take it back for healing. There is a bottle of Tianxiang Intermittent Ointment here, take it back and use it."
Tianxiang Breaking Ointment, a secret recipe unique to the royal family, has a miraculous effect on reconnecting broken bones. Linzhuang was flattered, took the plaster, led his disciples to lift Shen Gu and went away happily.
A good trick, this is really a slap in the face and a sweet date. Princess Yongle showed kindness and power at the same time. Linzhuang did not regret today's humiliation, but felt complacent because he received the medicine from the princess. It would probably be much easier if the royal family asked him to work hard in the future.
Princess Yongle said again: "Master Nangong, thank you for the hospitality. I won't bother you anymore and will go back to the palace. Everyone present, if there is a chance, we will meet again in the imperial city!" Summoning the spirit beast, he led King Jian to fly away.
Everyone said goodbye:"Farewell to your two highnesses!" As the people from Linzhuang and the royal family left one after another, the birthday banquet came to an end, and all the sects left one after another.
"It's finally over." Baiyunxi sighed. Nangong Xiu shook his head and said: "I'm afraid this matter is not that simple. Linzhuang and King Jian will definitely retaliate. If you provoke them, you may not be able to do well. By the way, how is Duofu's injury?"
Lu Duofu said: "Master, I'm fine."
Nangong Yue rolled her eyes at her: "You said it was okay, but you were vomiting blood. Dad, you have to give him a good look."
Nangong Xiu picked up Lu Duofu and said, "Of course, let's go back first." He then told the two elders: "Two junior brothers, take the disciples to heal!"
Gai Guang stepped forward and said, "Junior Brother Lu, thank you very much for today. I have offended my brother in the past, so please forgive me." These disciples used to look down on Lu Duofu, always a good-for-nothing. Today, this "trash" in their eyes not only won a game to avoid the embarrassment of being zero-blocked by Yunyin Sect, but also won a top-grade elixir for them. Gai Guang was sincerely grateful.
Nangong Yue snorted and said, "It's good to know. Seeing that you still dare to look down on Xiao Fuzi, you should thank him properly. If it weren't for him, you wouldn't be able to win a game."
All the disciples said one after another: "What Junior Sister Yue'er said is that we are incompetent and have brought shame on the sect, and we have to rely on Junior Brother Lu. From now on, whenever Junior Brother Lu is in need, we will do our best to help him."
Nangong Xiu smiled slightly: "Very good. Since we are from the same sect, we should work together and help each other. I don't blame you for what happened today. You have done your best. But from now on, you have to practice hard. Go, go down and recuperate."
"Thank you, Master, I'll take my leave!"
